pagina.chamada: Your base doesn't fit in a billionaire's algorithm
pagina.lead: Alumia is the activist social network of Instituto Lúcia: free, no ads, no algorithm and connected to the Fediverse. Bring your organization and call your base here.
pagina.para: For parties, elected mandates, unions, movements, collectives, student councils and student unions.
pagina.mosaicoRotulo: Sample action mosaic with the word VEM, almost fully lit; the gold card is you.
pagina.mosaicoLegenda: Each card is a person who confirmed attendance. On Alumia, an action looks like this.

linhas.tema: Who decides what your base sees
linhas.x: The company's algorithm, which changes without notice.
linhas.alumia: Nobody. Order of arrival: whoever follows you sees everything.

linhas.x: Can be bought, and drops whenever the algorithm wants.
linhas.alumia: Can't be bought and nobody cuts it: your post reaches your followers, in order.
Free software from Instituto Lúcia, connected to the Fediverse.
Actions, cells, base consultations, assemblies and accountability.
No ads and no tracking. Always a code name.
Every debate can become a lesson, every lesson can become a debate.

ferramentas.titulo: Tools to organize, not just to post
ferramentas.verNoExemplo: See it in the sample profile

atos.titulo: Call actions and watch your base light up
atos.texto: An action has a date, place, conversation and the mosaic: each confirmation lights a card. The organization sees how many are going; everyone else sees the word getting sharper. Postponed or cancelled? The stamp stays, nobody is caught by surprise.

consulta.texto: Consultations only cell members can vote in, with a deadline and a public result. The mandate says beforehand whether it will follow the result.
consulta.rotulo: Sample result of a base consultation

plenaria.texto: The base sends questions, the organization answers live, in order of arrival. Every vote goes into a table with the reason, for anyone who wants to check.
plenaria.rotulo: Sample question queue of an assembly

perguntas.texto: Why did the mandate vote against the parks concession?
When does the Sunday free-fare discussion come back?

nucleos.texto: Split your base by neighborhood, category or school. Link each debate to Instituto Lúcia's lessons. And talk to people on Mastodon, Lemmy and Misskey without leaving.

passos.texto: Code name, description and who looks after the account.
The team checks a public document: company registry number, party registration or certificate of election.
An invite link to your cells, with the first action already scheduled.

pagina.regra: Same rules for everyone: the badge says the account belongs to who it claims to be; it is not an endorsement by Instituto Lúcia. Verified organizations get no extra reach and follow the same care rules as the rest of the network.

selo.regra: The badge says the account belongs to who it claims to be; it is not an endorsement by Instituto Lúcia.
selo.semSelo: No badge yet: the team has not checked this organization's document.

perfil.sinoAjuda: The notification arrives without the post's text.
perfil.gerencio: You look after this account. Nobody else can see it's you.
perfil.capa: Cover of {codinome}: the word {palavra} in mosaic
perfil.semContagens: No follower count and no list of followers.
perfil.entreParaSeguir: Log in to Alumia to follow.
perfil.vazioAtos: No actions called by this organization.

nucleos.ajuda: The cell's facilitator accepts the request. Nobody sees the list of who is in a cell.
nucleos.vazio: This organization has no cells yet.

contas.intro: Every vote, with the reason and the public source, for anyone who wants to check.

registrar.fonteAjuda: Council website, minutes or official gazette (https address). Without a source, the vote is not recorded.

consulta.quorumNao: Quorum not reached: the result is not binding.
consulta.ranqueada: Ranked vote: put the options in your order (1 is your favorite). Counted by instant runoff.
consulta.secreto: The vote is secret: not even the organization sees what you voted. Once you vote you can't change it.
consulta.votei: Your vote was recorded. It's secret: only the total appears when the consultation closes.
consulta.naoPosso: Only members of this organization's cells vote.
consulta.resultadoDepois: The result is published for everyone when the consultation closes.

naSala.poucas: a few people in the room

plenaria.salaDepois: The room link appears when it starts.
plenaria.perguntaAjuda: Up to 280 characters. It goes to the end of the queue, in order of arrival: nobody jumps ahead.
plenaria.mostrarAjuda: If off, the question appears without your @.
plenaria.jaPergunte: You already sent a question to this assembly.
plenaria.ordem: in order of arrival, no staff filtering

pedir.intro: Create the organization's account and send a public document for the team to check. The badge only says the account belongs to who it claims to be.
pedir.entre: Log in to Alumia to request the badge. The organization's account stays separate from yours.
pedir.codinomeAjuda: The public name ("Mandata Popular"). No person's legal name.
pedir.handleAjuda: 3 to 20 lowercase unaccented letters, numbers or _.
pedir.cidadeAjuda: Just the city, typed by you. Alumia does not use your device's location.

docTipos.tse: Party registration with the electoral court
docTipos.ata: Founding or election minutes (student council, union, collective)

pedir.documentoAjuda: Only the organization's PUBLIC document. Never an ID or tax number of a person.
pedir.maior: Whoever looks after this account is 18 or older.
pedir.regras: Understood: the badge is not an endorsement by Instituto Lúcia and gives no extra reach. The organization follows the same rules as everyone.
pedir.privacidade: Whoever looks after the account is not shown to anyone: the link is stored separately and only released by court order. Political affiliation is sensitive data (LGPD, art. 11).
pedir.enviado: Request queued. The team checks the document and replies in your notifications.
pedir.docPessoal: This looks like a person's document (CPF). Send only the organization's public document.

exemplo.texto: This is a sample profile: the organization, the people and the numbers are made up, and nothing you do here is stored.

editar.ajuda: Shown on your profile to whoever can see the profile. Links only with https. No personal data (phone, address, tax number).

erros.semBanco: This part is not live yet.

cuidar.ajuda: Only the people who manage this account see this part. What you do here goes out in the organization's name; nobody sees it was you.

voto.fonteAjuda: Chamber website, minutes or official gazette: anyone can check.

pedidos.ajuda: Only the code name and @ of who asked. Declining does not notify the person.

consulta.compromisso: What the organization will do with the result
consulta.ajuda: Members of the organization's local groups vote. Once open, nothing changes: not the question, the options or the deadline.

plenaria.ajudaFila: The order is first come, first served and does not change. A question only leaves the queue for one of these reasons, and it is recorded.

gestores.ajuda: Only the account's creator adds or removes people. The list of managers does not appear anywhere, not even here.
